race_context: West Washington School Corp. is a two-school district in western Washington County based in Campbellsburg, with an elementary school and a junior-senior high school {nces_ww}{wiki_wwhs}. Federal data list 939 students and 69 full-time classroom teachers for 2024-25 {nces_ww}. Wikipedia lists Keith Nance as superintendent {wiki_wwhs}; a current district source confirming this could not be read.

The board has seven seats: Brown, Howard, Madison, Posey and Vernon townships, the Town of Campbellsburg and one at-large seat, according to a Washington County government roster that is several years out of date {wc_roster}. In 2024 Carri Jo Cambron won the Madison Township seat and Brian Farmer the Posey Township seat {enr_2024}.

Three seats are on the 2026 ballot, one member each: At Large, Brown Township and Howard Township {in_list}. In 2022 Tim Barksdale won the at-large seat (680 votes to 464 for Justin D. Davidson), Adam Brown won the Brown Township seat and Stephanie Keltner won the Howard Township seat, all in single-member races {enr_2022}. Barksdale is on the 2026 ballot for re-election; Brown and Keltner are not on the 2026 ballot {in_list}{enr_2022}.

The Town of Campbellsburg seat was also on the 2022 ballot (won by Claude C. Combs) {enr_2022}, but it does not appear on the 2026 state list {in_list}; how that seat is being filled could not be confirmed.

Party labels: 2026 is the first Indiana election in which school board candidates could declare a party; in this district Kyle Johnson and Brandon K. Davis are listed as Republicans, Katherine (Kate) M. Litts and Logan R Hall as Independents, and the rest as nonpartisan {in_list}.

Issues: news coverage of the West Washington board in 2025–2026 (budget, the 2025 property-tax law SEA 1, enrollment, staffing) could not be found or read for this profile; the district website blocks automated access and no local newspaper coverage was found.
Forums: no candidate forum, questionnaire or voter guide covering these races was found.
